arguments.sql_query:
WITH typical_ingredients AS (
    SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept WHERE concept_id IN (766529,794852,756018,733008,704984,700299,700465,792263,709699,745790)
),
atypical_ingredients AS (
    SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept WHERE concept_id IN (735979,785788,766814,757688,800878,712615,703244,40230761,19017241,40164052,35603277,46275300)
),
all_ap AS (
    SELECT ca.descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id, 'typical' AS class
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca JOIN typical_ingredients ti ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = ti.concept_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ca.descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id, 'atypical' AS class
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca JOIN atypical_ingredients ai ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = ai.concept_id
),
chronic_schiz AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT co.person_id
    FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.descendant_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
    WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 435782
),
exposures AS (
    SELECT de.person_id, CAST(de.drug_era_start_date AS date) AS index_date, ap.class
    FROM omop.drug_era de
    JOIN all_ap ap ON ap.drug_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
    JOIN chronic_schiz cs ON cs.person_id = de.person_id
),
first_date AS (
    SELECT person_id, MIN(index_date) AS index_date
    FROM exposures
    GROUP BY person_id
),
index_class AS (
    SELECT e.person_id, e.index_date,
           MIN(e.class) AS class_min, MAX(e.class) AS class_max
    FROM exposures e
    JOIN first_date f ON f.person_id=e.person_id AND f.index_date=e.index_date
    GROUP BY e.person_id, e.index_date
),
cohort AS (
    SELECT ic.person_id, ic.index_date, ic.class_min AS class
    FROM index_class ic
    JOIN omop.observation_period op ON op.person_id = ic.person_id
      AND op.observation_period_start_date <= ic.index_date
      AND op.observation_period_end_date >= DATEADD(day, 365, ic.index_date)
    WHERE ic.class_min = ic.class_max
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM omop.condition_occurrence pre
        JOIN omop.concept_ancestor pca ON pca.descendant_concept_id = pre.condition_concept_id
        WHERE pre.person_id = ic.person_id
          AND pca.ancestor_concept_id = 4140090
          AND pre.condition_start_date < ic.index_date
      )
),
outcomes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.person_id
    FROM cohort c
    JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co ON co.person_id = c.person_id
      AND co.condition_start_date >= c.index_date
      AND co.condition_start_date < DATEADD(day, 365, c.index_date)
    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor pca ON pca.descendant_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
    WHERE pca.ancestor_concept_id = 4140090
)
SELECT c.class,
       COUNT(*) AS n_patients,
       SUM(CASE WHEN o.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_parkinsonism_12mo,
       CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS decimal(10,2)) AS rate_percent
FROM cohort c
LEFT JOIN outcomes o ON o.person_id = c.person_id
GROUP BY c.class
ORDER BY c.class;

content.text:
Yes. In this OMOP EHR cohort, typical antipsychotics had a higher observed 12-month parkinsonism rate than atypical antipsychotics among patients with chronic schizophrenia.

| Antipsychotic class | Patients | 12-mo parkinsonism cases | Rate |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Atypical | 241 | 2 | 0.83% |
| Typical | 61 | 1 | 1.64% |

Crude risk ratio ≈ 1.98, but the counts are very small, so this should be interpreted cautiously and not as a statistically robust effect estimate.

Cohort definition used:
- Chronic schizophrenia: OMOP/SNOMED concept `435782` descendants.
- Typical antipsychotics: haloperidol, chlorpromazine, fluphenazine, perphenazine, trifluoperazine, thioridazine, thiothixene, loxapine, molindone, pimozide descendants.
- Atypical antipsychotics: risperidone, olanzapine, quetiapine, aripiprazole, clozapine, ziprasidone, paliperidone, lurasidone, iloperidone, asenapine, cariprazine, brexpiprazole descendants.
- Outcome: parkinsonism concept `4140090` descendants within 365 days.
- Required 12 months observable follow-up and excluded prior parkinsonism before index exposure.
